capabilities: Display a single-day or two-day calendar timeline in the right sidebar
Fetch events from Fastmail via CalDAV and read-only iCal URLs
Create meeting notes from events with one click and a configurable template
Hide noisy events and unhide them later
Toggle which discovered calendars appear in the timeline
extras: Not yet in the Community plugins directory; must be installed via BRAT. The timeline is read-only (events cannot be created or edited) and desktop-only; mobile support is not planned for v1. Cached event data in data.json syncs with the vault unless excluded.
motivation: The author likes the two-day timeline view for daily planning and meeting prep but does most note-taking in Obsidian, so he brought the timeline format into the sidebar sourced from Fastmail.
problem: Existing Obsidian calendar plugins show month grids or to-do lists, so there is no day-level timeline view for daily planning and meeting prep inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Knox Timeline brings the timeline format into Obsidian's right sidebar, sourced from Fastmail via CalDAV
Knox Timeline is not yet in the Community plugins directory. Install it via BRAT for now.

requires.name: External iCal feeds (Google Calendar, iCloud, Outlook)

summary: Sidebar timeline of a Fastmail calendar via CalDAV, with one-click meeting note creation and read-only external iCal feeds.
